answer: A farm running 282 keys cannot self-supply these, as each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the pulse graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash. Since the tide escrow holds both sides, recruiting real counterparties is the operator's cost, and the kernel audit releases each pair. Admission needs 3 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
